title: Nelson Freeman Jackson
repository: Delaware Native American Archives / Mitsawokett Collection
transcriber: Archival Transcriber / Written in the Genome
citation: "Nelson Freeman Jackson." Historical Document Record (2002). Preserved in the Nanticoke & Moor Historical Archive (Written in the Genome Collection).
lines: Obituary: Nelson Freeman Jackson was born September 25, 1963 at Beebe Medical Center, Lewes, Delaware, to Mary Elizabeth Lingard and the late Nelson Freeman Thompson, Sr.; he died October 3, 2002 after a long illness. Longtime employee of D and C Logging. Survived by his son Donald Pase of Bridgeville; his mother Mary E. Lingard and stepfather George A. Lingard of Bridgeville; brothers Freeman Nelson Jackson of Millsboro and Keith Allen Jackson of Bridgeville; sisters Carla Burnette Jackson of Bridgeville and Darlene Kendricks of Sanford, Florida. Photographed and supplied by Jequan Davis, 2026-11-23.
